lines.lyric_hangul: 아무리 적응해도 아닌 것 같아 네가 웃고 있는 게
lines.lyric_translation: No matter how hard you try / I don’t think you’re really smiling

lines.lyric_hangul: 누가 봐도 어색해 뭔가 너무 복잡해
lines.lyric_translation: Anyone can see you’re feeling awkward / What’s so complicated?

lines.lyric_hangul: 넌 몰라 몰라 알고 있는 것 같지만
lines.lyric_translation: You don’t know though / You think you know

lines.lyric_hangul: 뭔가 달라 달라 네 주변을 잘 찾아봐
lines.lyric_translation: Something’s different / I’m looking around you

lines.lyric_hangul: 웃으면서 갔던 놀이공원에서
lines.lyric_translation: We went to the amusement park while smiling

lines.lyric_hangul: 많은 추억도 쌓고 그랬는데
lines.lyric_translation: Made a lot of memories but

lines.lyric_hangul: 뭔가 변했어 something change
lines.lyric_translation: Something changed, something change

lines.lyric: Yetnare naye chueogeun shigani meomchwobeorin Neverland
lines.lyric_hangul: 옛날에 나의 추억은 시간이 멈춰버린 Neverland
lines.lyric_translation: My past memories are frozen in time like Neverland

lines.lyric_hangul: 뭔가 예전엔, 사소한 것까지 말했었던 너였었는데 멀어진 느낌
lines.lyric_translation: You used to tell me / Every little thing back then / But now I feel distant

lines.lyric_hangul: 몰라 왜 이래 오히려 내가 묻고 싶은 질문이야 뭔가 좀 달라진 듯이
lines.lyric_translation: I don’t know why / I want to ask you / Something’s different

lines.lyric: Nappeujin aneunde eosaekhae neoreul bol ttae mwonga
lines.lyric_hangul: 나쁘진 않은데 어색해 너를 볼 때 뭔가
lines.lyric_translation: It’s not bad but it’s awkward when I see you

lines.lyric_hangul: 네가 아닌 듯해 예전에 네가
lines.lyric_translation: Doesn’t seem like you, I miss you from back then

lines.lyric_hangul: 그리워 지려 해 벌써
lines.lyric_translation: I’m not used to seeing you changing like this

lines.lyric_hangul: 변한 네 모습 적응 안돼서
lines.lyric_translation: You’re changing

lines.lyric_hangul: 어딘가 달라지고 있어
lines.lyric_translation: No matter how hard you try to hide it

lines.lyric: Amuri sumgyeodo da bol su itneun geol
lines.lyric_hangul: 아무리 숨겨도 다 볼 수 있는 걸
lines.lyric_translation: I can see everything

lines.lyric: Dareun saramgwa yaegireul haneun geot gata
lines.lyric_hangul: 다른 사람과 얘기를 하는 것 같아
lines.lyric_translation: Feels like I’m talking to someone else

lines.lyric_hangul: 어색해져 너와 있을 때
lines.lyric_translation: It feels awkward when I’m with you

lines.lyric: Daeche eodil gan geoya neoye geu yeppeun miso
lines.lyric_hangul: 대체 어딜 간 거야 너의 그 예쁜 미소
lines.lyric_translation: Where did your pretty smile go?

lines.lyric: Wonak jal utteon neoraseo deo geuriwojyeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 워낙 잘 웃던 너라서 더 그리워져
lines.lyric_translation: You used to smile so easily so I miss it even more

lines.lyric: Naegen da boyeo an geureon cheok eosaekhan miso
lines.lyric_hangul: 내겐 다 보여 안 그런 척 어색한 미소
lines.lyric_translation: I can see everything, that awkward smile

lines.lyric_hangul: 밝았던 너라 더 걱정이 돼
lines.lyric_translation: You used to be so bright so I’m even more worried

lines.lyric: Neol bogo shipeo neol bogo shipeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 널 보고 싶어 널 보고 싶어
lines.lyric_translation: I miss you I miss you

lines.lyric_hangul: 행복한 입이 귀에 걸린 널
lines.lyric_translation: You, who used to happily smile

lines.lyric: Kkok bol su isseo nan bol su isseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 꼭 볼 수 있어 난 볼 수 있어
lines.lyric_translation: I can see you, I can see it

lines.lyric: Naega aldeon neo daun balgeun moseub
lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 알던 너 다운 밝은 모습
lines.lyric_translation: The you that I used to know that was so bright

lines.lyric_translation: What are you thinking about?

lines.lyric_hangul: 내 말 듣긴 했니
lines.lyric_translation: Are you even listening to me?

lines.lyric_hangul: 너 답지 않은 그 모습 지친 내 눈에만 보이는 듯해
lines.lyric_translation: It’s not you / Only I can see it through my tired eyes

lines.lyric: Eoril jeok neoye dansunhami bulgwa myeot nyeon saie
lines.lyric_hangul: 어릴 적 너의 단순함이 불과 몇 년 사이에
lines.lyric_translation: Your childish simplicity has changed in a matter of a few years

lines.lyric_hangul: 복잡함으로 폭풍성장해서 널 괴롭히네
lines.lyric_translation: It grew rapidly into complexity, torturing you

lines.lyric: Jom deo mam pyeonhi jabsaenggak naeryeonwa
lines.lyric_hangul: 좀 더 맘 편히 잡생각 내려놔
lines.lyric_translation: Lay down all those excess thoughts

lines.lyric_hangul: 그냥 너 걱정돼서 한 말이야 왜 또 째려봐
lines.lyric_translation: I’m just saying out of worry, why are you glaring at me?

lines.lyric_hangul: 그런 표정으로 어두운 표정으로 그런 표정으로 쳐다보지 마

lines.lyric_hangul: 너의 눈을 피하기도 싫어
